trajectory.reasoning:
To implement `power_diagram_edges`, we need to iterate over the facets of the regular triangulation. In a 3D regular triangulation (which `RT` is based on `CGAL::Regular_triangulation_3`), the dual of the triangulation is the Power Diagram. 

The dual vertices of the Power Diagram are the orthogonal centers of the tetrahedra (cells) of the regular triangulation. An edge in the Power Diagram exists between the dual vertices of two adjacent tetrahedra. Two tetrahedra are adjacent if they share a common facet.

The `threshold` is typically used to filter out edges that are too short or to handle infinite cells. In CGAL's `Regular_triangulation_3`, the `dual` method provides the orthogonal center of a cell.
